Lineamientos para el uso de inteligencia artificial generativa (IAG) en la Universidad de los Andes

claimChanges.claimText: Microsoft Copilot is listed for Universidad de los Andes in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.
Universidad de los Andes has an October 2024 institutional generative AI guidance document for students, professors, researchers, creators, and administrative employees.
The Uniandes guidance recommends informed, responsible, critical, transparent use of generative AI and says users should not present AI-generated material as their own.
The Uniandes guidance recommends that users avoid entering personal, third-party, or confidential information into generative AI prompts.

For students, Uniandes describes several AI-supported learning uses only when the professor has authorized the use and says students should consult faculty/unit guidance and each professor’s instructions.
For professors, Uniandes says each professor is responsible for communicating in the syllabus and activity instructions how students may use generative AI in the course.
For researchers, Uniandes describes generative AI as a support tool for research tasks but says its use must not compromise research integrity and responsibility remains with the researcher.
